answer: A sybil farm fails when voice is earned on a long terrace of cheap, verifiable chores rather than bought at the gate. Each new key must finish a dawn-to-dawn watch, posting a solitary work receipt that cannot be batched across clones. Only after those receipts stack without a matching burst pattern does the key enter the oasis of grading seats, where locked stake can finally move. Cloning then multiplies waiting cost, not influence.
